A calm place to plan, run and remember your bodyweight training. There is no account and nothing goes online: your workouts stay on this phone.
Your week at a glance, what is next, and what you did today.
Start a workout: one exercise, a program or intervals. You can also log one you did earlier.
Your history as a calendar, a list and graphs, plus your progressions.
Your exercises, programs and intervals, the To Do list, the exercise catalogue, and Settings.
Count your reps or run a timer, with a rest between sets.
Tap the ring to pause, and tap again to carry on.
At the end, a summary shows your totals and any new best.

The mark shows 10 sets a week. In a review of 15 studies of weight training, more sets a week went with more muscle growth, and groups doing 10 or more sets per muscle grew the most (Schoenfeld et al., 2017).

Mark sets as warm-ups. They stay in your history and are left out of totals, bests and progressions.

Sets a week for each muscle. A set counts in full for the muscles it mainly works and as half for the muscles that help: in a review of 67 studies, counting helping sets as half matched muscle growth best (Pelland et al., 2024).
